keyFindings.description: The production Cloud SQL instance that stays on POSTGRES_16 until INFRA-572 also holds the secrets broker's database and the five Legion daemon databases (dispatch://INFRA-572/spec). This PR moves the broker's CI (envoy-go, broker-multiprocess) and the daemon's whole Go suite (pr-and-main test) to the 18 image, and dispatch-go-postgres-16 runs only cmd/dispatch, internal/dispatch and internal/pgmigrate. A broker or daemon change that needs Postgres 17+ now passes every CI job and fails on production. Fix: run the broker packages (./cmd/broker/... ./internal/broker/...) and the daemon's Postgres-backed suite on the 16 digest until INFRA-572 too (INFRA-573 deletes them with the Dispatch lane), and make the PR body's 'fails CI before it reaches production' claim true for all of them.

The printed sequence removes the old container with `docker rm` and the put-back removes the new one with `docker rm -f`, both without -v, so the old 16 data directory (an anonymous volume) stays on the host; docs/testing.md:45 requires `docker rm -f -v` for the Postgres images. Print -v in both places (named volumes are untouched by -v).

For a stopped container the sequence prints `docker start` then pg_dumpall at once; a server still starting refuses, the redirect leaves an empty dump, the restore of nothing prints no errors, the two checks still print 1 and 18xxxx, and the next steps remove the backup container and the dump. Print the pg_isready wait after the start too, and make one check read the restored data (e.g. list pg_database) before the removal steps.
